data.one_liner: A Flutter table widget with virtualization, sorting, and custom cell rendering.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable table that renders only visible rows for performance. Supports column sorting, custom cell widgets, tooltips, and configurable column widths and alignment.
use_when: Displaying large data sets that need fast scrolling
Needing sortable columns or custom cell content
Wanting a lightweight, pure‑Flutter table without external native code
avoid_when: Very small tables where a simple ListView suffices
Require spreadsheet‑style editing, pagination, or complex formulas
Need built‑in export or import features
strengths: Highly customizable cell rendering and validation
weaknesses: Limited to basic table features; no built‑in pagination or editing
No code generation or declarative schema support
May lack advanced features found in dedicated data‑grid packages
